mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in a given month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) after inflation crosses above 0.3%, or the S&P 500 20-day return is flat while inflation accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage growth pressures that prompt equity market participants to anticipate higher corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite sustained wage growth above 0.5%, or unemployment rate falls while PAYEMS growth persists.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% suggests strengthening consumer demand, which elevates expected corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST month-over-month growth > 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward return is negative despite two consecutive months of >2% HOUST growth, or retail sales decelerate in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 95.0 triggers a supply-side shock narrative, causing investors to discount future cash flows and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) after INDPRO crosses below 95.0, or manufacturing recovers while the signal persists.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.25% for two consecutive months, the expected path of discount rates rises, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS month-over-month > 4.25% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) after two months of >4.25% FEDFUNDS, or FEDFUNDS declines while SPX rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% after a prolonged uptrend signals a softening labor market, reducing equity risk aversion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly closes fall below 4.5% after a 3-month rising trend
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5% as predicted, or unemployment rises while UNRATE remains low.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 2020 Q4 averages for two months indicate a dual-demand recovery, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both month-over-month > 2020-Q4 averages for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the dual-demand signal, or one series recovers while the other stagnates.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in both INDPRO and HOUST below their 2019 Q4 averages for three consecutive months indicates structural supply constraints, which amplifies earnings risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both month-over-month < 2019-Q4 averages for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the multi-month supply shock, or either index recovers while the other remains weak.
